Familiarity with service mesh (Istio) and edge/WAF tooling (Cloudflare). Familiarity with data infrastructure (Airflow, Databricks) and messaging/streaming systems (RabbitMQ, Kafka, DynamoDB, MongoDB). Knowledge of network security, vulnerability management, and incident response best practices. Experience with Rollbar or centralized logging pipelines. Experience in fintech, testing automation, and/or compliance-heavy environments (GDPR, SOC2). Prior leadership in scaling platforms for e-commerce or high-growth startups.
